correctness.rationale: Full face sets enumerated for all 3 <= n <= 10, total-directed-Hasse topological-sort acyclicity checked, exact oriented signed Morse boundaries computed via finite gradient recursion, and their only nonzero integer Smith factors are units (one at n=8, two at n=9).
